note: MP PBE/PBE+U band gaps of decomposition/SEI product phases. Nd-bearing gaps are lower bounds (4f mis-placement). Wide gaps => electronically insulating interphase.
caveat: PBE gaps underestimate systematically - use ORDER, not absolute eV. min_product_gap is the bottleneck: one metallic product makes the whole interphase electronically leaky (no self-limiting passivation).
